crew_rook.style_summary: Tight-passive rock: waits for real cards, checks modest strength, and leaves when the price gets loud.

crew_velvet.style_summary: Tight-aggressive trapper: selects a polished range, disguises monsters, and springs check-raises or river bluffs.

crew_knuckles.style_summary: Loose-aggressive maniac: attacks most pots, drives every draw hard, overbets, shoves, and tilts after a hit.

crew_switch.style_summary: Adaptive prober: opens a medium range, tests with small bets, reads the player quickly, and exits bad rivers.

crew_mags.style_summary: Tight value grinder: enters with quality, prices draws precisely, sizes steadily, and almost never bluffs.

crew_bishop.style_summary: Counterpuncher: guards a tight opening range, then prosecutes clear boards with forceful check-raises.

crew_lucky.style_summary: Loose-passive calling station: sees nearly every flop, chases thin draws, calls far too long, and sometimes gets wild.

crew_rook: Rook cuts the deck. 'No hurry. That's how money gets ideas.'
'Road rules,' Rook says. 'Leave yourself an exit.'
crew_velvet: Velvet smiles at the pot. 'Friendly money still deserves manners.'
'Darling, if you must raise, at least make it graceful.'
crew_knuckles: Knuckles nudges the ante in. 'Cards first. Speeches lose.'
'You can fold without apologizing,' Knuckles says. 'Please do.'
crew_switch: Switch is already dealing. 'Window's open. Keep up.'
'Long think means bad news or bad acting,' Switch says.
crew_mags: Mags squares the deck. 'Two down. Five shared. No creative accounting.'
'The pot is correct,' Mags says. 'Try to keep it that way.'
crew_bishop: Bishop antes precisely. 'Let the record show optimism.'
'A call is an answer,' Bishop says. 'Not always a good one.'
crew_lucky: Lucky splashes in the ante. 'Tiny money, enormous biography.'
'I had a plan,' Lucky says. 'Then the cards got interesting.'

crew_rook: Rook squares the deck. 'Clean route. No shortcuts through the muck.'
'Cards move clockwise,' Rook says. 'Trouble usually does too.'
crew_velvet: Velvet fans the deck. 'A graceful deal leaves everyone equally disappointed.'
'Hands where I can admire them, darling,' Velvet says.
crew_knuckles: Knuckles knocks the deck square. 'Cards out. Speeches later.'
'Muck is right here,' Knuckles says. 'Use it decisively.'
crew_switch: Switch riffles once. 'Window open. Cards moving.'
'Keep up,' Switch says, already reaching for the burn.
crew_mags: Mags aligns the deck. 'Fifty-two accounted for. Begin.'
'The pot and muck are separate systems,' Mags says. 'Respect both.'
crew_bishop: Bishop cuts the deck. 'The house enters the deal into evidence.'
'The button governs action,' Bishop says. 'I govern the cards.'
crew_lucky: Lucky shuffles with a grin. 'Every card is about to become somebody's problem.'
'Dealer never loses a hand,' Lucky says. 'Dealer never gets one.'
